entries.wording: ННВ створено. Очікуємо передачу вантажу до відділення SAT.
entries.note: The tracker's script shows it when the waybill exists but the cargo has not reached a SAT branch yet.
First step of the tracker page's progress bar, lit once the cargo is accepted at a SAT branch.
Second step of the tracker page's progress bar, lit while the cargo travels between terminals.
Third step of the tracker page's progress bar: arrived at the delivery branch; the script also lights it for a handover to a courier and for a delivery attempt.
Last step of the tracker page's progress bar, lit when the cargo is issued or delivered to the consignee.
History state in the sample reply of SAT's archived tracking API documentation.
History and current state in the sample reply of SAT's archived tracking API documentation: arrived at the issuing warehouse.
The sender listed the waybill for a SAT pickup, before the branch accepted the cargo; the tracker page lights no step for it.
Arrived at the terminal that serves the delivery branch.
At the delivery branch, waiting for the courier who takes it to the door.
Arrived at the branch that issues the cargo.
Issued to the recipient at the branch.
Brought to the recipient by a courier; the wording is the same as for cargo issued at the branch.
The tracker page's script lights its first step for it: the waybill is made out.
The tracker page's script puts it on the road step: waiting to be handed to a partner's network.
The tracker page's script puts it on the road step: arrived at the first terminal.
The tracker page's script puts it on the road step: left the first terminal.
The tracker page's script keeps a delay on the road step.
The tracker page's script puts a redirected waybill on the road step.
A delivery attempt; the tracker page's script puts it on the arrival step.
A written-off waybill: the tracker page's script reports it as not found (ННВ не знайдено), and so does the adapter.
